summary.text: The verifier reproduced the trailing-dash bug and found no regressions in existing tests, but Break My Fix found inputs the fixed slugify still mishandles (slugify('-') returns '-' and slugify('[^a-z0-9 -]') returns 'a-z0-9--'), so the evidence level is COUNTEREXAMPLE. Look first at why leading/trailing and repeated dashes survive in those cases, and at the two behaviour changes the Judge labelle…

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: The issue's exact example: 'Hello World!' should no longer produce the trailing-dash slug 'hello-world-'.

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: The issue's rule that slugs should not carry dangling dashes from punctuation or whitespace removes the lone '-'; an empty slug is a plausible result.

labels.label: suspicious
labels.reason: The new output 'a-z0-9--' ends in a double dash, the very kind of broken slug the issue complains about.

labels.label: suspicious
labels.reason: '/' now joins 'posts' and 'hello' without a separator, against the docstring's 'dash-separated slug', and the trailing dash remains.

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: Leading punctuation no longer leaves a stray dash, the same rule as the issue's trailing-punctuation case applied at the start.

survivors.description: Underscores are wrongly allowed in slugs.
